title: Forza Horizon Tuner
description: A desktop tuning app that turns a car, its upgrades, and a racing discipline into a ready-to-enter Forza tune. Computes real spring rates from sprung corner weight and target ride frequency, listens to the game's live UDP telemetry feed, and runs a discipline-aware coach that flags handling issues from real driving and offers one-click fixes.

title: Franky
description: A hardware health monitor for a four-machine fleet: Rust collectors read sensors on each box, a Rust hub stores readings in PostgreSQL, and a Python agent turns findings into plain-language answers about what is failing, since when, and what it means. Built as a spec-first project with the design, decisions, and test plan written down before the code.

title: Quest Log
description: A self-hosted learning tracker for coding practice and AI/ML curricula. Structured paths break down into modules, tasks, and day-by-day schedules with markdown task content, per-task notes, progress statistics, and a GitHub-style activity heatmap. Ships with seeded curricula and a Docker setup for production and hot-reload development.

title: Media Scout
description: A full-stack media discovery platform that aggregates trending movies and TV shows from TMDB, providing personalized recommendations based on genre preferences and rating thresholds. Features smart caching, duplicate prevention, and streaming platform availability.

title: Demo Lens
description: An enterprise-grade Counter-Strike 2 demo analysis platform with 99% event coverage. Features interactive heatmaps, 27 analytics services, AI-powered insights, and a microservices architecture spanning .NET, Python, Go, and Node.js.

title: Cine Sync V2
description: An AI-powered recommendation engine featuring 8 deep learning models including BERT4Rec, GraphSAGE, and T5. Processes 150M+ ratings across streaming platforms with real-time personalization, a web admin dashboard, and Discord bot integration.

title: Chameleon
description: A cross-platform CLI tool for network identity management. Supports MAC address spoofing with vendor prefixes, VPN integration (NordVPN, ExpressVPN, WireGuard), SOCKS proxy routing, application-specific rules with scheduling, and geolocation-based spoofing.
